title: OF GOD THE FATHER. IX. LORD'S DAY.

segments.text:
Queſt. 25d. What believeſt thou, when thou ſayeſt,
I BELIEVE IN GOD THE FATHER ALMIGHTY, MAKER OF HEAVEN AND EARTH?

Anſ. That the eternal Father of Our Lord Jeſus Chriſt, (Who of nothing made Heaven and Earth, with all that is in them; Who likewiſe upholds and governs the ſame by His eternal Counſel and Providence) is for the Sake of Chriſt His Son, my God, and my Father; on whom I rely ſo entirely, that I have no Doubt, but He will provide me with all Things neceſſary for Soul and Body: And further, that He will make whatever Evils He ſends upon me, in this Valley of Tears, turn out to my Advantage; for He is able to do it, being Almighty God; and willing, being a faithful Father.
